text: Strava crowns the fastest. We celebrate everyone else.
Every ride earns its own awards. Year bests, season firsts, streaks.
Tap a ride to replay it in 3D, colored by power.
Fifty kinds of awards, measured against your own history.
Power curves that know how tired you were.
And every ride you've ever done, on one map.
Everything runs in your browser. No servers.
Try the demo, at ay-yoo dot I-O.
